# Rule: Calling convention changed via a macro

_Canonical rule slug:_ `calling-convention-changed-via-macro`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> An exported function's calling convention changes through the expansion of a convention macro defined in an included config header, while the declaration text in the public header stays identical.
